name: trial-e6
description: Add-on calibration for E6 (run once per machine, after the machine's first trial and before its first E6 main run): a probe pass of every E6 cell (22 signature schemes x sign and verify x 5 message sizes; first call + 5 calls, unbatched). It derives only the E6 cells' fast/slow classification (probe median below 1 ms = fast) and batch sizes, with the first trial's rules; every other threshold of the machine stays unchanged. Canary every 5 minutes.
